findings.title: Redis cache with non-SSL port enabled
findings.description: azurerm_redis_cache with enable_non_ssl_port = true accepts plaintext Redis connections, exposing credentials and data in transit.
findings.remediation: Enforce TLS 1.2+. Set `min_tls_version = "TLS1_2"` / `minimum_tls_version = "1.2"`, replace HTTP listeners with HTTPS, and redirect HTTP→HTTPS. Disable weak ciphers and old protocol versions.

findings.title: PostgreSQL flexible server with public network access enabled
findings.description: azurerm_postgresql_flexible_server with public_network_access_enabled (the provider default) exposes the database to the internet. Disable public network access and use VNet integration or private endpoints.
findings.remediation: Remove public exposure. Restrict ingress to known CIDR ranges, disable public network access (`public_network_access_enabled = false`), and use private endpoints / Private Link if external access is required. Verify with `az network nsg rule list`.
